Questions

Before you call

What is the fastest way to get an answer?

The phone. 708-935-4289. There is one number and it goes to Mike Walsh. If you would rather text, texting photos of the room or the front of the house is genuinely the most useful thing you can send.

What should I have ready?

The town, roughly what needs doing, and an idea of the age of the house. For an interior, how many rooms and whether you want the trim and ceilings included. For an exterior, how many stories and what the siding is. None of it has to be exact.

Will I get a price on the phone?

You will get a useful idea of what is involved and what tends to move the number. You will not get a final price, because the two things that decide an interior job are the condition of what is already on the wall and how much trim there is, and neither of those is visible over the phone.

Do you charge to come out and look?

Ask when you call. It is a fair question and you should get a clear answer before anybody drives out, not after.
